description: My name is Bernice Mireku-North and I serve as Delegate for District 14, Montgomery County, which includes various neighborhoods of Silver Spring (Colesville, Fairland, Briggs Chaney), Burtonsville, Brookville, Spencerville, Laytonsville, Olney and parts of Damacus and Clarksburg.
